02-linked-scatterplot-matrix.visual_critic_note: Deliberate Paul Tol-style palette (#4477AA/#EE6677/#228833) with muted fills and KDE diagonals shows real design intent, but the legend sits awkwardly flush at the bottom edge and axis tick labels are nearly too small to read at rendered size.
02-linked-scatterplot-matrix.encoding_integrity_note: Honest encoding throughout — data-driven domains via d3.extent, correct zero baseline on KDE areas, Silverman bandwidth rule, no size-encoding deception — only minor robustness gap is absent key functions on scatter joins, harmless since joins are static.
02-linked-scatterplot-matrix.stress_test_note: Brush fires a full scatter opacity pass (12 cells × 200 circles) plus live KDE recomputation over 100 ticks × 3 species × 4 diagonal cells on every mousemove with no debouncing or requestAnimationFrame; the dispatch source parameter is threaded through but never checked in the listener to guard against self-updates.
02-linked-scatterplot-matrix.cognitive_load_note: 16-cell SPLOM reads as one conceptual unit with a clean 3-color palette and well-separated species clusters, but 150px cells are near minimum viable size and moderate point density in sepal-dimension cells requires effort to parse structure.
